name: Delivery to forwarder, mailbox or address unrelated to buyer
description: Goods or cards are shipped to freight forwarders, reshippers, mail drops or addresses with no storage or sales operations or link to the buyer.
fp: Expatriates and online shoppers legitimately use forwarding services.
